title: Implement 5 Recommendation Agents

risks: Ollama API timeouts on large models (kimi-k2.6). 60s timeout set. Agents fallback to ERROR on failure.
next_step: Run full test suite and commit

title: Sprint 2 Complete: Agent Recommendation Workflow

risks: Ollama API latency on kimi-k2.6:cloud (1T params) may cause timeouts. DeepSeek and Qwen models respond in ~6s. Live agent runs require sufficient timeout.
